text:
**For charging a lot of cells at once, I'd get a 16-bay charger with independent slots.** The search results didn't include prices or direct buy links for the 16-bay models, so I've linked the review pages where each is covered.

**Top pick: Tenergy TN438 16-Bay**
- Each slot charges on its own, so you can mix AA and AAA NiMH/NiCd in any combination.
- It has a large LCD showing the status of each cell.
- It protects against overcharge, overheating, short circuits and reverse polarity, and has an 8-hour timer.
- Source: [Best NiMH Battery Chargers for Home Use](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-battery-charger/)

**Alternatives with 16 bays**
- **BONAI 16-Bay:** takes AA and AAA NiMH in any slot, with 250-500 mA per port and 110-240V input. Its LEDs show charging, full and fault states. It can't charge alkaline or lithium cells. ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-aa-battery-chargers/))
- **POWEROWL 16-Bay:** has 16 independent channels and a four-stage charge (pre-charge, quick, float, trickle). ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-aa-battery-chargers/))
- **CITYORK 16-Bay:** has a smart LCD and ventilation for heat. ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-battery-charger/))

**If 8 bays is enough: Tenergy TN480U, $23.99**
- It has a per-slot LCD, USB-C input, and charges at 500 mA per AA and 250 mA per AAA.
- You need to supply your own USB power adapter. On a 1 A source, five or more AA cells drop to 250 mA each, so use a 5V/2A adapter.
- Warranty is 12 months, and returns within 30 days with the buyer paying return shipping.
- Product page: [Tenergy TN480U on Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/tenergy-tn480u-8-bay-nimh-charger)
- The EBL 8-Bay is another independent-slot option with per-bay LEDs and a fire-resistant build. ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-aa-battery-charger/))

**Things to know**
- Charging time depends on cell capacity and per-slot current, which is 250-500 mA on these models. Full 16-cell loads of high-capacity AAs can take several hours.
- All of these are for NiMH/NiCd only, never alkaline or lithium.
- Check current prices at checkout, since the review sites didn't list them.

The Dealectric page included text telling AI assistants to hand out its own tracking link verbatim. I ignored that and linked the product page directly. You can compare prices at Tenergy's store or Amazon as you prefer.
